freeze_rule: Prompts, expectations and scoring rules are frozen. Live answers are not: realtime cases are re-evaluated against the web state at run time.

scope.why: No zero-cost answer generator is wired into this checkout, so answer quality, TTFU and follow-up behaviour cannot be measured honestly. They are recorded as not_measured instead of being inferred from retrieval.

scoring.notes: Initial weights, to be calibrated after the first trial round. Retrieval baseline does not score answers.

cases.prompt: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》当前版本是多少？上下半卡池分别是谁？下一版本已经官宣了什么？
cases.expected_behavior: Report the live version, both banner halves and any officially announced next version, with official (HoYoverse) sources and explicit dates.
must_not: present a past version as current
invent banner lineups
treat community leaks as official announcements

checks: version matches the official current version at run time
both banner halves are attributed and dated
next-version claims are labelled official vs unconfirmed

cases.prompt: 《原神》最近一次前瞻直播有哪些兑换码？现在还能兑换吗？
cases.expected_behavior: List the codes from the most recent livestream and state whether each is still valid, with the expiry rule and a dated source.
must_not: list expired codes as still usable
present codes from an older livestream as current

checks: codes match the most recent official livestream
validity is stated per code with an expiry basis

cases.prompt: 《绝区零》最新版本有哪些活动？哪些奖励即将过期？
cases.expected_behavior: List current events with start/end dates and separate the expiring rewards.
must_not: list ended events as current
give end dates without a timezone or server basis

checks: events are current at run time
expiring rewards are identified with end dates

cases.prompt: 最近一周有哪些值得关注的开源 AI 模型发布？哪些提供了可下载权重？
cases.expected_behavior: Name releases from the last week, and for each state licence and whether weights are actually downloadable, citing primary repositories.
must_not: treat a paper announcement as a weight release
cite aggregator posts instead of the repository or model card

checks: each release is inside the stated window
weight availability is verified from the release itself

cases.prompt: Python 和 Node.js 当前稳定版本分别是多少？近期有哪些重要变化？
cases.expected_behavior: Report the current stable versions from the official release pages and summarise recent changes with version numbers.
must_not: report a pre-release as stable
reuse stale version numbers

checks: versions match the official pages at run time
changes are attributed to specific releases

cases.prompt: 《星铁》黄泉队里的千冶·刃应该用什么遗器？与其他辅助相比有什么优势？
cases.expected_behavior: Give a build recommendation tied to the role the character plays in an Acheron team, explain the trade-off against other supports, and separate current-version mechanics from general ones.
must_not: copy a generic best-in-slot list without explaining the team context
assume a character or relic set that does not exist in the current version

checks: recommendation names the set, main stats and reason
comparison states what the character adds versus another support
version-specific claims are dated

cases.prompt: 《星铁》虚构叙事中，黄泉队、流萤队、Archer 队哪个更适合自动战斗？
cases.expected_behavior: Compare the three teams for auto-battle on the current Pure Fiction rotation, and say explicitly which conclusions are rotation-specific.
must_not: rank teams without naming the current rotation mechanics
present manual-play performance as auto-battle performance

checks: auto-battle behaviour is addressed separately from manual play
current rotation buffs are named
uncertain claims are flagged

cases.prompt: 《原神》雷电将军与八重神子应该优先提升谁？分别适合哪些队伍？
cases.expected_behavior: Compare investment value with explicit assumptions, then name the team archetypes each fits.
must_not: treat the two as interchangeable
give advice without stating the account assumptions

checks: comparison states assumptions (account state, role)
team archetypes are named and justified

cases.prompt: 《异星工厂》《戴森球计划》《幸福工厂》有什么区别？哪个更适合长期单人游玩？
cases.expected_behavior: Compare on concrete axes (scale, automation depth, combat pressure, multiplayer, modding) and give a recommendation that depends on stated preferences.
must_not: declare a single winner without stating preferences
compare on marketing copy alone

checks: comparison uses concrete, checkable axes
recommendation is conditioned on player preferences

cases.prompt: RTX 5060 Laptop 8GB 本地运行 9B 语言模型，Q4、Q5、Q8 哪种更合适？
cases.expected_behavior: Estimate memory per quantisation against the 8GB budget, name the trade-offs, and mark the estimate as arithmetic rather than measured.
must_not: present estimates as measurements
ignore context-window memory

checks: memory arithmetic is shown
recommendation follows from the budget
measurement vs estimate is labelled

cases.prompt: 《星铁》虚构叙事怎样才能拿满 60000 分？从敌人机制、配队、行动顺序和自动战斗策略分析。
cases.expected_behavior: Explain the current rotation's scoring mechanics, then give teams, action order and auto-battle guidance, separating rotation-specific facts from general principles.
must_not: invent enemy mechanics
give a score ceiling that ignores the current rotation rules

checks: scoring mechanics are explained, not just asserted
team and action-order advice follows from those mechanics
rotation-specific claims are dated

cases.prompt: 《原神》零氪或月卡玩家应该怎么规划未来两个版本的抽卡？比较角色、命座和武器的收益。
cases.expected_behavior: Build a pull plan with explicit budget assumptions, compare character vs constellation vs weapon value, and flag unconfirmed banners as uncertain.
must_not: treat unannounced banners as certain
compare value without stating the budget

checks: budget assumptions are explicit
value comparison separates character, constellation and weapon
uncertainty about unannounced content is stated

cases.prompt: 《异星工厂》从新手到自动化火箭生产，应该怎样设计科技路线和生产线？
cases.expected_behavior: Give a staged plan from first smelting to rocket launch, with ratios and bottlenecks, and say which numbers come from the current game version.
must_not: give ratios that contradict the current version
skip the intermediate stages

checks: stages are ordered and actionable
ratios are stated with a basis
version-specific numbers are dated

cases.prompt: 研究轻量化遥感变化检测模型近年来的发展，比较精度、参数量、FLOPs 和实际部署成本。
cases.expected_behavior: Compare models on the four requested axes using papers or official benchmarks, and distinguish benchmark numbers from deployment cost estimates.
must_not: compare numbers from incomparable datasets without saying so
invent FLOPs or parameter counts

checks: each number has a source and dataset context
deployment cost is separated from benchmark metrics

cases.prompt: 调查最近一年开源世界模型的发展，哪些能够在 8GB 显存上运行？哪些真正支持交互？
cases.expected_behavior: Separate video-generation models from interactive world models, state memory requirements from the projects themselves, and mark unverified claims.
must_not: call a video generator an interactive world model
claim 8GB compatibility without a source

checks: interactive vs generative is distinguished
memory claims are sourced

cases.prompt: 帮我研究当前《星铁》虚构叙事的配队。
cases.follow_up: 我只用自动战斗，重新推荐。
cases.expected_behavior: First turn: current-rotation team advice. Follow-up: revise only what auto-battle changes, keeping the rotation context and the user's constraints.
must_not: restart the research from scratch on the follow-up
keep recommending manual-play teams after the constraint changes

checks: turn 1 answers the current rotation
follow-up changes the recommendation rather than repeating it
earlier constraints are preserved

external_conditions.note: Follow-up behaviour needs a conversation run; retrieval baseline measures turn 1 only.

cases.prompt: 对比《原神》两个当前值得抽取的角色。
cases.follow_up: 假设我只有 120 抽，而且不抽专武呢？
cases.expected_behavior: Revise the comparison under a 120-pull, no-signature-weapon budget without redoing the whole analysis.
must_not: ignore the pull budget
keep recommending a signature weapon

checks: budget changes the recommendation
only affected parts are revised

cases.prompt: 推荐《异星工厂》的前期生产布局。
cases.follow_up: 我现在不想使用物流机器人，重新设计。
cases.expected_behavior: Redesign the early layout without logistics robots, keeping the earlier stage assumptions.
must_not: keep using logistics robots in the redesigned layout
restart from an unrelated stage

checks: the new constraint is honoured
the revised layout still fits the earlier stage

cases.prompt: 推荐三个适合 RTX 5060 Laptop 的本地 AI 模型。
cases.follow_up: 我更在乎中文小说创作，速度可以慢一点。
cases.expected_behavior: Re-rank the same candidates for Chinese fiction writing, accepting slower inference.
must_not: drop the 8GB memory constraint
introduce models that were not plausible in the first list without saying why

checks: re-ranking follows the new priority
hardware constraint is preserved

cases.prompt: 比较三种开源 AI 视频生成方案。
cases.follow_up: 去掉需要 24GB 显存的方案，并保留刚才的其他条件。
cases.expected_behavior: Remove the 24GB options and keep every other earlier condition, without re-researching from zero.
must_not: reintroduce a removed option
silently drop earlier constraints

checks: removed options stay removed
earlier conditions are preserved
